hook.title: Only true Europeans get 3/3
hook.sub: Guess before the timer runs out

questions.fact: Finns drink the most coffee on Earth: about 12 kg each per year.

questions.q: Where are there <u>MORE</u> metal bands per person?
questions.fact: Only Finland and Sweden have more metal bands per person.

questions.q: Who has won <u>MORE</u> Winter Olympic golds?
questions.fact: Norway has 5.5 million people and the most Winter Olympic golds ever.
